package consumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/migrations/backend"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/schema/ir"
)

const (
	createModel backend.RelationMigrationOperationKind = backend.RelationMigrationCreateModel
	deleteModel backend.RelationMigrationOperationKind = backend.RelationMigrationDeleteModel
	addField    backend.RelationMigrationOperationKind = backend.RelationMigrationAddField
	removeField backend.RelationMigrationOperationKind = backend.RelationMigrationRemoveField
)

var (
	_ backend.RelationRevisionFencedBackend = (*relationBackend)(nil)
	_ backend.RelationRevisionFencedSession = (*relationSession)(nil)
)

type relationBackend struct{}

func (*relationBackend) OpenRevisionFencedSession(context.Context) (backend.RevisionFencedSession, error) {
	return &relationSession{}, nil
}

func (*relationBackend) RelationMigrationCapabilities() backend.RelationMigrationCapabilities {
	return backend.RelationMigrationCapabilities{
		CreateModelForeignKeys:            true,
		AddNullableForeignKey:             false,
		AddRequiredForeignKeyToEmptyTable: false,
		RemoveForeignKeyByTableRemake:     false,
	}
}

type relationSession struct{}

func (*relationSession) ReadAppliedMigrations(context.Context) ([]backend.AppliedMigration, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (*relationSession) BeginFencedMigration(context.Context, backend.HistoryTransition) (backend.RevisionFencedTransaction, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (*relationSession) BeginRelationFencedMigration(context.Context, backend.HistoryTransition, backend.RelationMigrationIntent) (backend.RevisionFencedTransaction, error) {
	return nil, nil
}

func (*relationSession) Close(context.Context) error { return nil }

func relationIntent(model, targetModel ir.Model, sourceField, targetKey ir.Field) backend.RelationMigrationIntent {
	return backend.RelationMigrationIntent{Operations: []backend.RelationMigrationOperation{{
		OperationIndex: 0,
		Kind:           createModel,
		After:          model,
		Targets: []backend.RelationMigrationTarget{{
			SourceField: sourceField,
			TargetModel: targetModel,
			TargetKey:   targetKey,
		}},
	}}}
}
